row.title: A measure taken early
row.body: A small item is kept ready beside a tool for routine work; neither label says what made the precaution necessary.
row.rival_reading: Routine handling could explain the paired supplies; the arrangement alone does not establish a program or a response failure.
row.gloss: A prepared pair is left without a clear account of why it was needed.
